verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official MCP server so users can "query Ramp data and take actions with natural language" from ChatGPT, Claude, and similar assistants. The docs give concrete prompt examples ("Lock my card", "Show me our top software vendors by spend this quarter", drafting missing-receipt reminders) and cover reads, approvals, edits, policy Q&A and purchases, with role-based admin controls. A probe confirms the server is live and OAuth-gated with granular read/write scopes. missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface (the NL layer relies on external assistants), bill approvals via MCP (documented as not yet available), independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language command reliability.
